caseName: Houston Belt & Terminal Railway Co. v. Wherry
caseNameFull: Houston Belt & Terminal Railway Co. v. Wherry

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. Civ. App. Tex., 1st Sup. Jud. Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
